title: Choosing and accepting consequences remain distinct from generating
text: The interview distinguishes asking worthwhile questions, selecting useful outputs and committing to action. Its execution-trap discussion warns that people can become busier producing artifacts after the bottleneck has moved elsewhere. These distinctions help specify what employees must learn and what accountable reviewers must actually do.
qualification: Conceptual interview discussion, not validated psychological categories or evidence that human judgement is universally superior.
